name: Doki Doki Exit Music Epilogue
storyline:
Exit Music: Epilogue is a fan-made continuation of the popular DDLC mod Exit Music. Set after the events of the original mod, Epilogue follows the emotional aftermath experienced by the characters as they try to rebuild their lives and cope with the consequences of past events. The story focuses on healing, closure, and the strength found in human connection, presenting a more introspective and character-driven narrative.

It offers a deeper look into the struggles and growth of familiar characters, answering unresolved questions and delivering a heartfelt conclusion to the Exit Music saga. With its mature tone and emotional depth, Exit Music: Epilogue provides a compelling and respectful follow-up that resonates with fans of the original.
summary: It is a small story that will bring the Exit Music saga to a satisfying close. It is a contained, perplexed, and emotional experience that will answer the lingering questions left behind by the original mod and its added content. I hope you all will enjoy our return album.
